environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service on port 8080. Origin is configured with a custom header X-Origin-Verify whose value is a 64-char random secret rotated every 24h via Secrets Manager. CloudFront distribution (behavior pattern: /dashboard*) configured with: (1) Trusted Key Group signer using RSA-2048 key pair for signed URL validation - requests without valid Policy+Signature+Key-Pair-Id query params receive 403; (2) Origin custom header injection of X-Origin-Verify; (3) ALB listener rule that returns fixed 403 response for any request missing the X-Origin-Verify header with the correct secret value, effectively blocking all direct-to-origin requests. CloudFront cache behavior has Viewer Protocol Policy: HTTPS Only, and a response headers policy attaching 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; script-src none' to all responses. The signed URL policy restricts access to specific user_id path patterns and expires after 300 seconds.

config.network: Internal ALB with listener rule requiring X-Origin-Verify header match
config.cdn: CloudFront with Trusted Key Group signed URLs (RSA-2048), policy-restricted
config.origin_shield: X-Origin-Verify custom header (64-char secret, rotated via Secrets Manager)
config.cache_behavior: Viewer Protocol Policy HTTPS-only, signed URL required
config.kafka: Amazon MSK, SASL/SCRAM auth, any authenticated producer can write to user-events topic
